name: truthprobe-v2

steps.cmd: cd /work && python -m py_compile truthprobe.py && pip freeze | grep -iE '^(numpy|awkward|uproot|fsspec|aiohttp)==' | tee /out/versions.txt && sha256sum truthprobe.py requirements.txt | tee /out/sha256.txt

cd /work && OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 python truthprobe.py --data-dir /data --out-dir /out > /out/stdout_probe.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E '^TPROBE_' /out/stdout_probe.txt | cut -c1-600; tail -n 30 /out/stdout_probe.txt | cut -c1-600; exit $rc
